notes.title: Timore 6: The Cadaver is out now
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33853531/c77573edc2ff85009f5986f711c9b1ab5cb23c93.png"][/img]The new "The Cadaver" story in Timore 6 is out now as a free update to the game.[/p][p]It is a prequel to Timore 6, answering many questions and bringing new mysteries about Vince, Rosa and the universe of Timore.[/p][p]Update Timore 6 and find the new content in the main menu -> Play -> The Cadaver.[/p][p]Thank you all and enjoy the nightmares![/p][p]- Vidas[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/972910/Timore_6"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Timore 6 Chapter 3 is out!
notes.content:
Chapter 3 is out now, this is the last chapter of Timore 6, features more creatures than the previous chapters did, more areas and concludes the story of Vince and Rosa. The 3rd chapter is added to the main game as a free update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33853531/b8a8af2e1b23b76c4cf8af8783147c1f56a5c463.png[/img]

notes.title: The 2nd chapter is out!
notes.content: Timore 6 has been updated with the 2nd chapter, thanks for being patient everyone! It's been added for free to the base game.

notes.title: Timore 6 v1.0.3 patch
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs regarding the park and Rufus.
Thanks to the players who did let me know about them!

notes.title: Timore 6 v1.0.1 patch
notes.content: v1.0.1 patch includes a small fix for the player's mouse input. The screen was a little jittery in the introduction, but now it's fixed with this patch.

notes.title: Timore 6 is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33853531/055b094c3ae953aa012f261ac85f3ae507487a4a.png[/img]
The first chapter of Timore 6 is out, I'm glad to see people are enjoying the game, thanks everyone for the support!
The game isn't over yet, the upcoming chapters are in development and your feedback is important, any comments, videos, ideas you got may help the game to improve, so thanks everyone for playing!
See you soon with the new updates!

Vidas

notes.title: Timore 6 is coming soon!
notes.content:
Timore 6 is almost here!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33853531/51a1ea554efcecb689334b446d257e8e47c9a66e.jpg[/img]

Thanks everyone for the support, this game definitely took the most time and effort to create (so far, regarding timore games), the introduction and a first chapter will be launching really soon. The other chapters will be released later on, continuing the story, providing new scares and giving you more and more content to see and to experience. Oh, and also, the upcoming chapters after the first one will be added to the base game for FREE!

Timore is back!

See you soon,

Vidas
